data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church that has raised $555M+ to date. The valuation peer set comprises 8 private and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health, including same-stage comparables Chai Discovery ($3.8B) and New Limit ($3.1B), as well as adjacent-stage peer Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

Only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis was excluded because the stated current valuation of $10.32B implies a multiple of 20.6x total capital raised—a red flag suggesting potential data misclassification. The peer-median method anchors on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables with a median valuation of $3.1B and a range of $539M to $3.8B.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $2.6B to $3.6B, with a median estimate of $3.1B. The primary uncertainty is the dependence on a single applicable method; triangulation across revenue multiples cannot be performed given the absence of target revenue disclosures typical in private companies. The wide interquartile spread among peers ($3.1B – $3.8B) reflects heterogeneity in technology maturity and clinical stage, both unresolved for this target.
